name: Button
title: Button
summary: Pill-shaped call-to-action button used across ISM's app, site, and print/email creative, available as the React `Button` and as `.btn` classes.
whenToUse: Use for actions: give, sign up, download, submit, open a section.
Use `primary` / `.btn-primary` for the ONE main action in a group. Everything else in that group is secondary, light, outline or ghost.
whenNotToUse: Do not use a button for plain navigation inside running text; use a link (see Link).
Do not use a button for a filter or toggle; use Chip.

anatomy.description: A pill with a label and an optional trailing icon. No shadow; hover darkens one step; no scale.
anatomy.markup: Classes: `.btn` + one colour class (`.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-light`, `.btn-outline-light`) + optional size (`.btn-sm` 36px, default 44px, `.btn-lg` 52px). `.cr-btn-block` makes it full width. `.arrow` nudges up-right on hover. `.spin` is the loading spinner.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Colour treatment. `primary` (solid Horizon Blue) is for the ONE main action in a group.
`outlineLight` and `ghost` suit light sections; `outlineDark` and `solidWhite` suit dark sections.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to the full width of the container.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a spinner and block interaction. The label stays and the width does not change. Sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Trailing icon element, for example `<UiIcon name="arrow-right" />` or an `↗` span. Hidden from assistive tech.

react.notes: `import { Button } from '@ism/ui'`. Renders a `<button type="button">` by default and an `<a>` when `href` is set (buttons do things, links go places), with the same `.btn` classes as the HTML.

props.name: variant
props.description: `primary` is the ONE main action in a group. `light` and `outlineLight` are for dark surfaces.

props.name: size
props.description: Heights 36, 44 and 52dp. Use `sm` only in dense desktop-like toolbars, never as a sole touch target.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a spinner in place of the leading icon and block presses. Sets busy accessibility state.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional trailing element, e.g. `<UiIcon name="arrow-right" mirrorInRTL />`.

variants.use_on: light or dark, the one main action
dark sections (also the header Give pill)

variantNotes: States: default, hover (one step darker), focus (2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`), disabled (`disabled` or `aria-disabled="true"`, 45% opacity), loading (`.spin` + "Sending…", keep it disabled; React `loading` sets `aria-busy` and the spinner comes from CSS).

states.documented: default, hover (one step darker), focus (2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`), disabled (`disabled` or `aria-disabled="true"`, 45% opacity), loading (`.spin` + "Sending…", keep it disabled; React `loading` sets `aria-busy` and the spinner comes from CSS).
states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: One Horizon Blue (`--horizon-blue`) button per group. Never two blues side by side.
Never use blue for other accents (progress lines, borders, dividers); use the gradient, gold, white or black (see Divider, AccentBar).
Keep every button at least 44px tall (`--tap-target`). `.btn-sm` (36px) is for dense desktop toolbars only.
Icons: ↗ = goes to another page, ⌄ = opens here, › = drills into an app screen. Put the icon after the label; a leading icon is fine for download or give.
Inside `.sec-ink`, `.btn-secondary` and `.btn-ghost` switch to their on-dark colours automatically.
Use `<a>` for navigation and `<button type="button">` for actions.
do: Use for actions: give, sign up, download, submit, open a section.
Use `primary` / `.btn-primary` for the ONE main action in a group. Everything else in that group is secondary, light, outline or ghost.
One Horizon Blue (`--horizon-blue`) button per group. Never two blues side by side.
Keep every button at least 44px tall (`--tap-target`). `.btn-sm` (36px) is for dense desktop toolbars only.
Icons: ↗ = goes to another page, ⌄ = opens here, › = drills into an app screen. Put the icon after the label; a leading icon is fine for download or give.
Inside `.sec-ink`, `.btn-secondary` and `.btn-ghost` switch to their on-dark colours automatically.
Use `<a>` for navigation and `<button type="button">` for actions.
dont: Do not use a button for plain navigation inside running text; use a link (see Link).
Do not use a button for a filter or toggle; use Chip.
Never use blue for other accents (progress lines, borders, dividers); use the gradient, gold, white or black (see Divider, AccentBar).
accessibility: The label must say what happens ("Give online", not "Click here").
A loading button keeps its width, gets `aria-busy="true"` and `disabled`.
Focus ring is always visible on keyboard focus; do not remove it.
content: Verb first, two to four words, sentence case: "Give online", "Download the app", "Become a partner", "Join the Mission".
